follow-up time: Through delivery and immediate postpartum period
exposure: Duration of latent phase of labor
cohort: 67,267 pregnancies in the Stockholm-Gotland Regions, Sweden, between 2008 and 2020
finding: A longer duration of the latent phase of labor was associated with increased odds of labor dystocia, related interventions (including cesarean delivery), chorioamnionitis, and neonatal morbidity.
